interpretation.label: commensurability_partially_collapses_scale_spread
interpretation.routing: exactly one of F1/F2 moved -> /failure-autopsy to adjudicate which half and why. NOT an automatic build and NOT an automatic close.

preconditions.name: G0_endogenous_trigger_mechanism_live
preconditions.description: every (arm x seed) 1e6 control burst fires at least once
preconditions.control: margin_threshold=1e6 guaranteed-fire burst (250 ticks/cell), matching contract test W11

preconditions.name: G1_commensurability_engaged_on_arm_only
preconditions.description: _last_commensurability_raw is non-empty on EVERY comm_on cell and empty on EVERY comm_off cell -- the manipulation engaged, and only where it was asked for
preconditions.control: the operator populates this dict itself; probed at authoring time as 5 channel keys under ON and {} under OFF

preconditions.name: G1b_commensurability_warmup_completed
preconditions.description: every comm_on cell's _chan_scale_n reached the configured warmup -- below it _commensurability_scale returns an exact 1.0 and the operator is a no-op while still reporting as engaged
preconditions.control: worst (minimum) _chan_scale_n over every comm_on cell; measured at authoring time as 75 after 600 ticks and 188 after 1500, against a configured warmup of 20

preconditions.name: G1c_manipulation_moves_the_dv
preconditions.description: the comm_on and comm_off median E3 margins DIFFER on EVERY seed -- the mechanical form of this run's DV-symmetry declaration. Equal medians mean the manipulation is invisible to the DV by arithmetic and F1/F2 are identities, not measurements
preconditions.control: paired same-seed comparison with a fresh env and a complete RNG reset per cell; measured at authoring time as OFF 0.13548 vs ON 0.17944 at 600 ticks on seed 0

preconditions.name: G2_eligibility_dv_sample_sufficiency
preconditions.description: every cell collected at least 50% of the FRESH E3 margin samples its schedule implies, so each cell's eligibility fraction -- the recruitment DV -- is a real statistic. Deliberately NOT a gate on the per-episode request count, which is rate-capped by the 51-tick coalition debounce and on which nothing routes.
preconditions.control: worst (minimum) fresh-margin sample count over every cell, against n_episodes x (ticks // e3_steps_per_tick) = 500 expected

preconditions.name: G3_off_arm_margin_spread_discriminable
preconditions.description: the comm_off reference arm's own cross-seed median-margin ratio -- without spread here there is nothing for normalisation to collapse and F1 would pass vacuously
preconditions.control: V3-EXQ-1038 published 605.7x on these same 7 seeds under this same condition, so this floor is cleared with ~60x to spare

preconditions.name: G3b_off_arm_is_scale_determined
preconditions.description: |Spearman rho| between per-seed median E3 margin and per-seed eligibility fraction in the comm_off arm -- the PREMISE this run tests the repair of. Without it there is no scale-determination for normalisation to remove and F2 would collapse vacuously
preconditions.control: V3-EXQ-1038's own published per-seed margins and recruitment give |rho| = 0.830 under this same condition, so this floor is cleared with 0.23 to spare

preconditions.name: G3a_off_arm_eligibility_cv_non_degenerate
preconditions.description: the comm_off arm's cross-seed ELIGIBILITY-FRACTION CV -- F2 is a HALVING test against this reference and would pass vacuously on a flat arm
preconditions.control: measured at authoring time on seed 5 at 250 ticks: eligibility 0.938 (comm_off) vs 0.328 (comm_on), so the statistic is live and moves

criteria.name: F1_on_arm_margin_spread_below_bar
criteria.threshold_note: ABSOLUTE pre-registered bar, fixed from V3-EXQ-1038's published 605.7x. Routes the LABEL, not the outcome.

criteria.name: F2_on_arm_scale_association_collapsed
criteria.threshold_note: |Spearman rho| between per-seed median E3 margin (SCALE) and per-seed eligibility fraction (RECRUITMENT). An ABSOLUTE pre-registered bar from V3-EXQ-1038's own |rho| = 0.830, NOT a ratio against a realised reference: the eligibility CV of a bimodal 7-vector is a function of how many seeds sit in the high mode, so a halving bar on it would be a statement about that split rather than about the operator (red-team pass 2, finding 1). Routes the LABEL, not the outcome.

criteria.name: F2c_eligibility_cv_halved_CONTEXT_ONLY
criteria.threshold_note: RECORDED, NOT ROUTED ON -- superseded by F2. Retained so a reader can see the statistic the first draft would have used and why it was withdrawn.

interpretation.combination_rule: G0 (with the other preconditions) decides the OUTCOME: all green -> PASS, meaning a valid instrument-verified measurement was obtained. F1 and F2 decide the LABEL and the routing: F1 AND F2 -> commensurability_collapses_scale_spread (no SD-091 build owed); NEITHER -> scale_spread_persists_under_commensurability (build owed); EXACTLY ONE -> partial, route to /failure-autopsy.
interpretation.null_reading: A null (F1 and F2 both false) means the existing divisive normalisation does NOT make recruitment scale-invariant on this harness. It does NOT by itself establish that the SD-091 threshold build is the right repair: the operator's own divisor is an equally live account (red-team F2; see this label's routing). It also does not bear on whether commensurability is correct for its OWN purpose -- that operator's validation is separately OPEN (V3-EXQ-1012a).
